+import { exec } from "node:child_process";
+import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
+
+export interface Settings {
+  theme: "light" | "dark";
+  pageSize: number;
+}
+
+const DEFAULTS: Settings = { theme: "light", pageSize: 20 };
+
+export interface ReportRequest {
+  title: string;
+  format: string;
+}
+
+export function convertReport(req: ReportRequest, done: (err: Error | null) => void): void {
+  exec(`pandoc ${req.title}.md -o ${req.title}.${req.format}`, (err) => done(err));
+}
+
+export async function sendReceipts(ids: string[], send: (id: string) => Promise<void>): Promise<number> {
+  ids.forEach(async (id) => {
+    await send(id);
+  });
+  return ids.length;
+}
+
+export async function loadSettings(path: string): Promise<Settings> {
+  let settings: Settings = DEFAULTS;
+  try {
+    settings = JSON.parse(await readFile(path, "utf8")) as Settings;
+  } catch (e) {}
+  return settings;
+}
+
+export function firstId(ids: string[]): string {
+  if (ids.length === 0) {
+    throw new Error("ids must not be empty");
+  }
+  return ids[0]!;
+}
+
+export function parsePort(value: unknown): number {
+  if (typeof value !== "string" && typeof value !== "number") {
+    throw new TypeError("port must be a string or number");
+  }
+  const port = Number(value);
+  if (!Number.isInteger(port) || port < 1 || port > 65535) {
+    throw new RangeError(`invalid port: ${String(value)}`);
+  }
+  return port;
+}
